definitions.explanation: A postcard or card sent to wish someone a happy New Year. Traditionally sent so that it arrives on January 1st.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{年賀状|ねんがじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: New Year's cards arrived on New Year's Day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{年賀状|ねんがじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm thinking about the design for this year's New Year's cards.

examples.japanese: {年賀状|ねんがじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十二月|じゅうにがつ}→十二月：00636_juunigatsu⟧⟦{二十五日|にじゅうごにち}→二十五日：noentry⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I send New Year's cards by December 25th.

notes:
USAGE: {年賀状|ねんがじょう} is an important New Year tradition in Japan. People send cards to friends, relatives, coworkers, and business contacts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年賀状|ねんがじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write New Year's cards)
- {年賀状|ねんがじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to send New Year's cards)
- {年賀状|ねんがじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}する→印刷する：21677_insatsusuru⟧ (to print New Year's cards)
- {年賀状|ねんがじょう}じまい (announcing you'll stop sending cards)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- ⟦{年賀|ねんが}→年賀：11175_nenga⟧⟦ハガキ→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧ (official New Year postcards from Japan Post) include a lottery number
- Cards must be sent by Dec 25 to arrive on January 1
- The design often features the year's Chinese zodiac animal (⟦{干支|えと}→干支：12449_eto⟧)
- "あけまして⟦おめでとう→おめでとう：01043_omedetou⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧" is the standard greeting
- If you receive a card from someone you didn't send one to, send a reply by January 7
- Do not send to people who are in ⟦{喪中|もちゅう}→喪中：06226_mochuu⟧ (mourning)

MODERN TREND: Many people are shifting to digital greetings (LINE, email), leading to the practice of {年賀状|ねんがじょう}じまい (announcing one will stop sending paper cards).
